P1.title: Point provenance can still be forged by editing both identity and clocks
P1.evidence: A real 3.000 ns directory copied to the 2.750 ns path passes after only point_identity and clocks.rpt are rewritten. Its mapped SDC still contains create_clock -period 3 and its timing/QoR/netlists remain the 3 ns evidence, yet the auditor reseals M99 at 2.75 ns.
P1.required_fix: Parse mapped SDC clock constraints and a backend-generated immutable point receipt; bind launch period, command line, SDC hash and all report/netlist hashes before postrun audit.

P1.title: Mapped artifact authenticity is presence-based
P1.evidence: A tiny correct-name module plus arbitrary nonempty mapped SDC, DDC and SVF is accepted as mapped_artifacts_present=true and receives a new PASS manifest.
P1.required_fix: Validate mapped SDC semantics and reopen/read the DDC/netlist with Synopsys; add mapped RTL-to-DDC or RTL-to-netlist equivalence/provenance rather than checking a module-name regex only.

P1.title: Manifest inventory is dynamic and path labels are not canonicalized
P1.evidence: Deleting check_design_precompile.rpt still passes with 373 entries. A newline-containing path passes with receipt count 375 but produces 376 physical lines and a duplicate run/admission.txt label.
P1.required_fix: Freeze the exact 374-label inventory or a schema-derived per-point inventory; reject control characters, duplicate normalized labels, absolute paths and traversal before hashing.

P2.title: QoR and detailed timing contradictions do not abort the seal
P2.finding: A MET/+0.0009 detailed report combined with negative QoR TNS silently converts the point to fail; the audit then selects 3.0 ns and still emits PASS.
P2.required_fix: Require status/slack/TNS/path-count coherence and abort on contradiction instead of treating corrupted evidence as an ordinary failing point.

P2.title: Both frontier points have effectively zero timing margin
P2.finding: M85 4.0 ns is MET at displayed 0.0000 ns and M99 2.75 ns is only +0.0009 ns.
P2.required_fix: Add guardbanded and locally bracketed scans before presenting robust frequency.

P2.title: M99 is censored by the lower grid boundary
P2.finding: There is no failing point below 2.75 ns, so 363.636 MHz is target closure, not measured continuous Fmax.
P2.required_fix: Extend the grid below 2.75 ns or retain the exact frozen-grid target wording.

P2.title: The flow remains ideal-clock ZeroWireload logic-only pre-macro
P2.finding: No CTS, routing parasitics, SRAM macro, post-layout timing, SAIF power or energy is included.
P2.required_fix: Keep area as mapped standard-cell area and frequency as DC target closure until macro/post-layout evidence exists.

P2.title: Same-function remains frozen-workload differential equivalence
P2.finding: The functional basis is latency-aligned directed and frozen-trace differential evidence, not exhaustive sequential equivalence for all states and inputs.
P2.required_fix: Use the workload-qualified wording or add exhaustive formal refinement.

paper_safe_statement: Across the frozen 16-point TSMC28 logic-only pre-macro target grid, current exact-SHA evidence shows M99 closes 2.75 ns while M85 first closes 4.00 ns, a 1.455x target-grid closure ratio; fastest-point mapped standard-cell area is 0.478x. This is not continuous or post-layout Fmax, module throughput speedup, system speedup, energy or headline PPA.
prohibited_claims: Do not call 1.454545x continuous Fmax or throughput speedup.
Do not call logic-only standard-cell area macro-inclusive area or PPA.
Do not call the r2 auditor fully fail-closed until point provenance, artifact authenticity and canonical inventory are repaired.
Do not promote this module target-grid result to full-network or system speedup.
